messages:
Alice M.: Heads-up — prepping for tomorrow's EU midnight change window. Quick readiness sweep: freeze starts 23:00 UTC, cutover 00:30 UTC. Please confirm pins/rollbacks and blockers by EOD.
Ben (eng-release): +1. PRs that touch routing are pinned. Two optional hotfixes queued — prefer to hold unless critical.
Carla (SRE): Checking canary smoke script results now, will post pass/fail in 5.
deploy-bot: [deploybot] Canary job started: canary-v2 -> eu-canary-01 (job 6723). Logs: https://ci/reports/6723
Dmitri: Noted. Are we keeping the embed model pinned to 1.4.2 for the window? Latency bloat last time with 1.5.
Alice M.: Yes — pin embeddings to 1.4.2 for the window. Add a note in release notes about potential tokenization diff if we later switch.
Carla (SRE): Canary smoke: kv cache warmup ok, p90 latency within SLO, a small error spike on /batch-infer that I'm investigating. Attach gist in sec. :eyes:
Carla (SRE): gist: https://gist.github.com/somehash (stack trace + metrics). Looks like a regression from the routing middleware change 3 days ago.
Ben (eng-release): Which traffic slice hit that path? If it's only admin traffic we can proceed.
Carla (SRE): It hit user-slice-3 — low volume but not admin-only. Recommend we hold full rollout until patch lands or we set a route exclusion.
Alice M.: Decision: hold the global rollout. We'll proceed with a limited fallback plan — keep canary running, don't advance to stable. Ben, can you cherry-pick a minimal revert/guard?
Ben (eng-release): I'll push a patch to gate the middleware behind a feature flag. ETA 45m.
Dmitri: I'll prepare rollback playbook entries: quick-pin instructions, traffic-shift commands, and a notify runbook.
Oncall-ops: I'll be on standby during the window (pager on). If anything hits >5% error rate or latency >2x p90, escalate here.
deploy-bot: [deploybot] Canary job 6723: health check passed 3/3, but rolling hold due to manual signal from #eng-releases.
Alice M.: Thanks everyone. Action items: Ben — FF to gate (45m). Carla — continue validation; post final canary health at +30m. Dmitri — rollback doc. Oncall — stand by. We'll reconvene 22:30 UTC for last go/no-go. :thumbsup:
Ben (eng-release): Patch pushed to branch hotfix/gate-middleware, PR #914. Running smoke tests.
Carla (SRE): Smoke tests green on the patch branch. If deploybot approves, I recommend progressive canary expansion to 10% after a 15m watch.
Alice M.: We'll keep the freeze at 23:00 UTC. If all green at 22:30 check-in, proceed with staggered canary expansion; if not, we'll abort the rollout and document the exemption.
Dmitri: Rollback doc uploaded: https://internal/docs/rollbacks/1705554321 (includes pin commands and rollback checklist).
Oncall-ops: I'll monitor and will ping #pager if thresholds trip.
Alice M.: Final note — update release notes with the embed pin and the middleware guard as known issues. Thanks, team.
